note: Designed MUSIC set (the going-dark score), generated by tools/audio/gen_music.py (decisions.md D41/D46). Mono 16-bit 24 kHz PCM WAVs; pal/src/bank.rs include_bytes!s each and resamples to the device rate at stream-open (names are the contract with pal::bank::MUSIC_ASSETS / the MusicId enum). combat_bed is the looping bus under a match; win_stinger / lose_stinger are one-shot match-end punctuation on the music bus. Presentation-only — never the sim (invariant #1/#4). Regenerate with `pnpm assets:music`.
identity: one A-minor tuning shared with the SFX set: a low tense drone bed, a rising major-lift win, a falling minor lose. The bed loops seamlessly by whole-cycle construction (no fade / no IIR filter in its master pass).
source: Csound 6 (offline additive synthesis, no noise -> deterministic) + SoX -D (no dither)
author: procedurally synthesised via Csound + SoX

sounds.name: combat_bed
sounds.role: the looping ambient combat bed — the going-dark mood bus under a match
sounds.design: tense A-minor drone (root+detuned-beat+fifth+octave+minor-third), whole-cycle partials for a seamless loop, normalized quiet to sit under the SFX mix

sounds.name: win_stinger
sounds.role: the match-won musical punctuation (one-shot on the music bus)
sounds.design: rising A3->C#4(major lift)->E4->held A4+E5 open chord — triumphant, resolved

sounds.name: lose_stinger
sounds.role: the match-lost musical punctuation (one-shot on the music bus)
sounds.design: falling A4->F4->E4->held low A3+C4 minor third — somber, sinking
